newsitem.title: USA: Aliant access, cell subscribers rise.
newsitem.headline: Aliant access, cell subscribers rise.

text.p: Aliant Communications Inc said Friday its telephone access lines, access minutes and cellular subscribers grew in the third quarter.
Access line growth was 3.3 percent versus third quarter 1995, and access minutes, an indicator of long-distance calling volume, grew 6.5 percent for the quarter versus last year.
Cellular subscribers in the markets in which the company has a wholly owned interest grew to 133,194 during the third quarter in 1996 from 95,720 in 1995.

"Our cellular operations turned in strong gains in customers, revenues, and operating income and generated 25.7 percent of total operating revenues," Frank Hilsabeck, president and chief executive of Aliant, said in a statement.
Subscribers to Navix, its Internet access service, grew 39 percent during the quarter, Aliant said.
Aliant said it repurchased 90,000 common shares during the third quarter, with the total number of repurchased shares under the original 600,000 share authorization now 381,000.
